newsitem.title: JAPAN: MMC, Proton to jointly develop small cars - paper.
newsitem.headline: MMC, Proton to jointly develop small cars - paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp (MMC) will jointly develop two small cars in Malaysia with Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton), a Japanese newspaper reported on Friday.
The Yomiuri Shimbun said MMC had agreed with Proton to jointly develop two small passenger cars to go on sale in 2000.
No immediate comment from MMC was available because Japanese carmakers including MMC have closed their offices and plants in Japan due to holidays from April 26 until May 5.
MMC and Mitsubishi Corp each own 8.6 percent of Proton.
The daily said the cars will be mainly developed by Proton, with MMC providing technical assistance.
MMC chairman Hirokazu Nakamura visited Malaysia in late April to set the details, the daily said.
Proton will develop the platforms and other major parts for the cars, which will be powered by MMC-made engines, it said.
Proton already produces three cars based on MMC vehicles.
